topic.label: Physics
topic.desc: Physics: from fundamental theory to simulation, instrumentation and astronomy.

concepts: Quantum states, qubits, wavefunctions, entanglement and decoherence, simulated and analysed numerically.
Newtonian mechanics: motion, forces, momentum, energy, collisions and orbits.
Special and general relativity: Lorentz transformations, four-momentum and curved spacetime.
Elementary particles, leptons and quarks, accelerators, detectors and decay chains.
Heat, entropy, engines, ensembles and phase transitions.
Maxwell fields, circuits, waves, interference and ray optics.
Stars, galaxies, spectra, redshift and the expansion of the universe.
Finding preprints, symbolic derivation and unit checking across all physics.
skills: Builds and runs qubit circuits with noise models and returns measurement histograms, circuit statistics and result types.
Solves the time-independent and time-dependent Schrodinger equation for a potential and reports wavefunctions and energy levels.
Computes entanglement entropy, decoherence and quantum-state fidelity for multi-qubit states and master-equation dynamics.
Calculates projectile motion with and without drag, fits trajectories and checks energy and momentum conservation.
Simulates rigid bodies, joints, collisions, torque and angular momentum and records trajectories with events.
Estimates circular orbit period, escape velocity and orbital energy from mass and radius.
Applies Lorentz transformations for time dilation, length contraction and relativistic velocity addition.
Traces geodesics of massive and light-like bodies in a Schwarzschild spacetime and reports proper time.
Computes four-momentum, invariant mass and energy thresholds for relativistic particle collisions.
Simulates charged particle tracks in electric and magnetic fields of a linear accelerator or synchrotron and reports beam energy and orbit radius.
Looks up particle mass, charge, spin, lifetime and decay modes from particle data tables using natural language.
Lists decay channels and branching ratios of leptons, quarks and hadrons and follows a decay chain to stable products.
Analyses Carnot and Otto cycles for work, heat flow, entropy production and efficiency.
Computes partition functions and Boltzmann distributions and detects phase transitions in model systems.
Simulates heat conduction and diffusion on a mesh with boundary conditions and reports temperature fields.
Solves Maxwell equations and electrostatic and magnetostatic fields for a geometry and reports field maps.
Models interference, diffraction and lens ray tracing and renders intensity patterns.
Computes transient and steady-state response of resistor, inductor and capacitor circuits.
Queries astronomical survey catalogs for objects, retrieves spectra and converts data to FITS.
Converts redshift to luminosity and comoving distance under a Hubble expansion model.
Models stellar interior structure, luminosity and evolution from mass and composition.
Searches arXiv preprints, reads full text and summarises what is known about a physics question with citations.
Derives and checks equations symbolically and numerically with a computational knowledge engine.
Checks dimensional analysis and unit conversions across a derivation or simulation input.
